name: WriteTextToJSONFileNode
label: Write Text to JSON File
description: Writes the provided content as JSON to the specified file path.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: JsonContent
fields.label: JSON Content
fields.description: The content to write as JSON. Can be a string, object, array, JsonObject, JsonArray, List, Dictionary, etc.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full path to the file where the JSON content will be written.
